title: Malicious code in @jayhackpro/jayshield (npm)
description: The npm package @jayhackpro/jayshield version 1.2.1 contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise includes potential unauthorized access to all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to the extent of control the malicious code may have established, full remediation cannot be guaranteed by removal alone.
